standard_prerequisites.name: Both traces are additive on direct summands of finite projective modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies the reduction to the free rank-one case.

core_obligations: By additivity of the traces it suffices to treat P = Lambda[G] (proof line 1669). There the endomorphism f is right multiplication by an element sum lambda_g g of Lambda[G] (proof lines 1669-1671). In the basis of group elements, the matrix of right multiplication has entry lambda_{g_2^{-1}g_1} in position (g_1, g_2) (proof lines 1671-1673). The diagonal entries satisfy g_2 = g_1, i.e. g_2^{-1} g_1 = e, so every diagonal coefficient equals lambda_e, and there are #G of them (proof lines 1673-1674). Hence Tr_Lambda(f; P) = #G lambda_e = #G Tr_Lambda^G(f; P) (proof lines 1674-1675).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to P = Lambda[G] by additivity (proof line 1669).
Compute the diagonal of the right-multiplication matrix and compare with the epsilon-augmented trace (proof lines 1671-1675).
